title: Hampi: Giant Boulders Among Ancient Temples
description:
Hampi in Karnataka is a landscape of giant boulders scattered and balanced across the land, with ancient temples among them. It was once the capital of the Vijayanagara empire and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Hampi #IndiaFacts
